description: Reopen r-sort-3b-mix (General) read-only. On MR (K TEXT(20), V1 Double): reads the stored (ID, K, V1); the ID sequence of SQL ORDER BY K, V1; V1, K; K DESC, V1; K, V1 DESC; K DESC, V1 DESC; K, V1, ID; and the table-type walk reading ID of each of the five compound indexes forward and backward; then every index's metadata. Asks the public order and the physical traversal of Text-plus-Double compounds in all four direction combinations, with Null, case-tied and zero partners, and the tie order between keys that compare equal.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
